pages.title: Train Add-ons
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points**

- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Steam 'n' Rails**: new gauges, Monorail and Phantom track, bogeys, switches and couplers.
- **Railways Navigator**: route search, display boards and Penalty Anchors.
- **Train Utilities**: sliding train doors in dozens of styles.
Several mods extend Create trains: Steam 'n' Rails for new track and parts, Railways Navigator for route information, Train Utilities for doors, and Xaero Train Map for the map.

pages.title: Steam 'n' Rails
pages.text:
Steam 'n' Rails adds:

- **Track:** Wide and Narrow gauge, a Monorail, and Phantom track that fits any [#](7A3C9A)[bogey](entry://glossary/bogey)[#](). Track also comes in many wood and stone styles.
- **Parts:** many more bogey designs, couplers, buffers and a handcar.
- **Styling:** blocks for locomotives such as boilers and smokestacks.

pages.title: Track Switch
pages.text: Use to cycle right, sneak-use to cycle left. Redstone sets it. A comparator reads 1 left, 0 straight, 2 right.

pages.title: Semaphore
pages.text: Sits on a pole above a [#](2E5AAC)[Train Signal](entry://transport/train_signals)[#]() and shows its state. Two stacked show if some or all exits are blocked.

pages.title: Train Coupler
pages.text: Couples and decouples trains without taking them apart. [#](2E5AAC)[A wrench](entry://create_basics/tools_wrench)[#]() changes the mode and the gap between pads.

pages.title: Conductor's Cap
pages.text: Conductors can press buttons and flip levers when a player looks at them, unless that player wears another colour of cap.

pages.title: Conductor Whistle
pages.text: Bind it to a conductor riding a train, then use it on a track or station to call that train. A deployer can use it on a station too.

**Remote Lens:** bind it to a conductor wearing goggles, then use it to look through their eyes.\
\
**Handcar:** a small rail cart; pick it up with a wrench.\
\
**Smokestacks** can be dyed, and soul sand or soul soil makes soul smoke.

pages.title: Railways Navigator
pages.text:
Adds:

- a **Navigator** item that lists connections with stopovers and live data
- Advanced Display boards, a Train Station Clock and a Lectern with Navigator
- **Penalty Anchors**, which add a cost to a stretch of track

pages.title: Navigator
pages.text:
Search for a route to a station and see the trains that run it, with delays and changes along the way.\
\
Route overlay options are on the \\ key.

pages.title: Advanced Display
pages.text: Platform and train destination boards. Wrench it to open the configuration screen.

pages.title: Penalty Anchor
pages.text: Trains pick the **cheapest path**. Raise the penalty with a wrench to push them onto another route. Redstone weakens it.

pages.title: Train Utilities
pages.text: Adds sliding train doors in dozens of real-world styles, platform and line blocks, and frameless glass. Some doors need small parts like Processing Units and Rubber Seals, made by [#](2E5AAC)[Create assembly](entry://create_basics/brass_and_assembly)[#](). Doors can be opened by hand or follow a moving [#](2E5AAC)[contraption](entry://create_basics/contraptions)[#]().

pages.title: Andesite Alloy Door
pages.text: One of many sliding doors. Create's own Train Door also exists as a simpler option.
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **In depth.** The pack uses an unofficial port of Steam 'n' Rails for 1.21.1, still in beta.

pages.title: Train map
pages.text: Xaero Train Map draws trains on Xaero's World Map. It only affects your own screen.
